verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents UI extension points such as custom views, dashboard gadgets or widgets, or a native-looking UI kit for building them. The available items only show related capabilities: generic 'Rich APIs' (developer building blocks), 'Extend Jira Software with apps' and 3000+ Marketplace integrations (not a documented custom-view or widget capability), and built-in board, list, timeline and calendar views (not user-built views). None of these count toward the story.
